scope: Source-backed interpretive labels after targeted source review and reconciliation; not independent human gold.

topic-001.summary: This broad cluster links socialist organizing to democratic goals. Bread & Roses emphasizes a united multiracial working-class movement; North Star puts democracy at the core of socialism. Labor organizing, electoral work, and international coordination appear together, rather than forming one agreed strategy.
topic-001.title: Socialist organizing and democratic aims

topic-002.summary: The statements describe capitalism through exploitation, class division, and concentrated economic power. Caracol connects accumulation to externalized social and ecological costs; Emerge describes exploitation of the working class. Sharing this vocabulary does not imply agreement on how to replace capitalism.
topic-002.title: Capitalism and economic exploitation

topic-003.summary: This overlapping theme combines organizational democracy with winning political power. Bread & Roses stresses member deliberation and voting; Socialist Majority discusses governing power and transformational reforms. These are related vocabularies, not interchangeable models of democracy or a consensus on the state.
topic-003.title: Democracy, parties and political power

topic-004.summary: Union activity and other organizing are presented as foundations of working-class power. Socialist Majority stresses collective action on the shop floor; Marxist Unity Group emphasizes militant, democratic unions; the Communist Caucus discusses labor and tenant organizations. This cluster extends beyond workplace-only policy.
topic-004.title: Labor organizing and working-class power

topic-005.summary: The sources debate DSA's role in building a larger socialist organization. Groundwork emphasizes its potential to become a mass party; Winter emphasizes a coordinated workers' movement; Bread & Roses describes a pre-party role. A shared focus on DSA should not be read as agreement about its destination.
topic-005.title: Building DSA as a mass organization

topic-006.summary: Class struggle is a framework for understanding political change and the divisions organizing must confront. Reform & Revolution describes history through class struggle, while Winter says liberation must involve the whole working class. The cluster also contains debate over oppression, constitutional institutions, and the limits of coalitions.
topic-006.title: Class struggle, division and solidarity

topic-007.summary: This heterogeneous cluster includes Marxist and materialist self-description alongside organizing methods. Reform & Revolution names its revolutionary Marxist tradition; Red Star invokes dialectical and historical materialism. Repeated normalization wording such as 'the group' also contributes to this cluster, so its share is not a clean measure of ideology.
topic-007.title: Political traditions and organizing approaches

topic-008.summary: The theme connects opposition to domestic oppression with international domination. LSC calls for abolition of policing and incarceration; Bread & Roses discusses anti-oppression campaigns; the Communist Caucus connects class power to opposing imperialist violence. The breadth of this cluster prevents treating it as a single foreign-policy position.
topic-008.title: Oppression, abolition and anti-imperialism

topic-009.summary: Caracol explicitly links degrowth and ecosocialism; North Star connects economic democracy to environmental responsibility; Emerge calls for a just global transition rather than green growth for the West. The cluster includes broader language about material outcomes and transformation, not environmental claims alone.
topic-009.title: Ecology and economic transformation

topic-010.summary: These claims address how DSA should change its organization and electoral practice. Groundwork emphasizes bottom-up democratic mechanisms; Marxist Unity Group proposes independent legislative caucuses even on a Democratic ballot line; Bread & Roses seeks independence from the Democratic apparatus. Critiques of internal culture and organizational limits also enter this broad theme.
topic-010.title: DSA strategy and internal debate

topic-011.summary: Springs of Revolution's proposals on repression and movement resilience appear alongside other revolutionary organizing strategies, including Reform & Revolution's simultaneous mass and revolutionary-core work. Proposal language and the word 'revolution' partly drive this heterogeneous cluster. It is not a single adopted policy or a distinct ideological camp.
topic-011.title: Campaign proposals and revolutionary openings

topic-012.summary: This small identity-heavy cluster centers on Red Star's self-description and North Star's own principles. Red Star describes itself as Marxist-Leninist, while North Star affirms democratization and opposition to oppression. Shared source-name wording contributes to the grouping; it is not evidence that these tendencies agree or share a separate substantive policy.
topic-012.title: Named tendencies and ideological identity
